info.title: Lineup API
info.description: The conventions are in docs/API.md. Every failure is a problem+json document.

put.description: Check a key with the provider, narrow it and seal it in a cookie

401.description: There is no key, or the provider refused it

403.description: Another site sent this, or the key may not do it

409.description: It needs a choice first, or the provider is still on it

429.description: Too many requests. `Retry-After` says how long to wait
